title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of One Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Relief of Indigent Sufferers From Typhoons, for Attending to Urgent Repairs of Public School Buildings Damaged By Typhoons, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of one hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the relief of indigent
sufferers from typhoons that may occur, and to attend to urgent repairs of public school buildings destroyed or
damaged by a typhoon.

The sum herein appropriated shall be spent in accordance with the provisions of section two of
Act Numbered Four thousand one hundred and sixty.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 6, 1935.
